correctness.rationale: The circular two-cover lemma supplies multiplicity <=2 for a minimal cover. Each strict 2/3 witness obeys e>=2z+1, forcing k>z. For N=4q+3, the next borderline would force two witness arcs to share all k marked sites and partition an odd number of unmarked sites into equal halves, which is impossible. A consecutive marked block meets the bound with arcs containing at most ceil(z/2) zeros. Full-orbit repeated intervals are reduced by averaging complete periods. All hypotheses and strict endpoint cases, including N=3, are covered. Exact enumeration through 14 corroborates but is not the proof.
